project.project_objectives: Build a full-featured iOS client that presents the project plan produced by this CrewAI planning crew
project_requirements: Create an iOS app that displays the plan generated by the planning crew
Load the plan from JSON shipped in the app so the demo works offline
Show the project name, objective, total estimated hours, and schedule range
List every task with its description, hour estimate, assignees, dependencies, and start and end days
Group the work into milestones and show which tasks complete each one
Display delivery risks in their own section
Show the team roster and the tasks assigned to each person
Use a SwiftUI interface that is readable on an iPhone during a live demo
Show a clear message when the bundled plan JSON cannot be read

tasks.description: Collect and document detailed project requirements from stakeholders.
tasks.allocation_rationale: John Doe, as Project Manager, is responsible for liaising with stakeholders to ensure requirements are accurately captured.

tasks.description: Create wireframes and design prototypes for the app interface ensuring clarity and usability.
tasks.allocation_rationale: Bob Smith is a Designer and will leverage his skills to create effective user interfaces.

tasks.description: Define the MVC architecture for the app, including data sources and API endpoints.
tasks.allocation_rationale: Jane Doe, as a Software Engineer, is adept at designing software architecture and can effectively create a blueprint for the application.

tasks.description: Set up the development environment, version control, and project structure in Xcode.
tasks.allocation_rationale: Jane Doe will set up the environment as she is familiar with Xcode and version control setups.

tasks.description: Create functionality to load and parse JSON data for offline functionality.
tasks.allocation_rationale: Jane Doe will implement this task, capitalizing on her engineering background to handle data parsing effectively.

tasks.description: Develop main screen to display project name, objective, total estimated hours, and schedule range.
tasks.allocation_rationale: Jane Doe will build this screen as it integrates data and requires engineering skills to implement correctly.

tasks.description: Create a task list view displaying each task's description, hour estimate, assignees, dependencies, and start/end days.
tasks.allocation_rationale: Jane Doe will handle this task to ensure that the task list is functional and well-integrated.

tasks.description: Group tasks into milestones and create functionality to show completion status for each milestone.
tasks.allocation_rationale: Jane Doe will develop this feature as it requires understanding of task statuses that she will have gathered.

tasks.description: Develop a section to display delivery risks associated with the project.
tasks.allocation_rationale: John Doe will create this section as he collects and understands project risks from stakeholders.

tasks.description: Create a screen showing team member names and their assigned tasks.
tasks.allocation_rationale: Jane Doe will implement this as she can easily access data regarding team member assignments.

tasks.description: Develop the app interface using SwiftUI, ensuring it is optimized for iPhone.
tasks.allocation_rationale: Jane Doe will use her development skills to create an engaging SwiftUI interface for the application.

tasks.description: Implement dark mode functionality within the app.
tasks.allocation_rationale: Jane Doe will implement this feature, as it requires attention to the UI developed in SwiftUI.

tasks.description: Display error messages for scenarios where the JSON plan cannot be read.
tasks.allocation_rationale: Jane Doe will handle this task since it is directly related to the functionality implemented in the app.

tasks.description: Conduct tests for bugs, usability, and overall performance using both QA engineers.
tasks.allocation_rationale: Both QA Engineers will test the application to ensure it is free from bugs and meets project standards.

tasks.description: Final review meeting with stakeholders and prepare documentation for app deployment.
tasks.allocation_rationale: John Doe will lead this task to ensure everything is in order prior to the app store submission.

risks: Delays in stakeholder availability for requirements gathering could impact timeline.
Potential complexity in integrating various SwiftUI components.
Significant bugs found during testing may necessitate additional iterations.
Last-minute changes by stakeholders could adjust project scope and timeline.
